## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL, with Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive (broad strength). Risk signals conflict: VXX (1W: -6.00% | 1M: +25.91%) CORRECTION shows fear easing this week but elevated over the month, while the SPY/TLT ratio is RECOVERY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -3.36%) and HYG/LQD is RECOVERY (1W: +0.05% | 1M: -0.67%).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear is easing short term: VXX (1W: -6.00% | 1M: +25.91%) CORRECTION, but its monthly rise keeps the signal mixed. Credit is mixed: HYG/LQD (1W: +0.05% | 1M: -0.67%) RECOVERY means slight weekly stress easing against a weaker monthly trend; copper/gold (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.24%) BELOW TREND flags cycle weakness.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Mixed: the dollar-strength indicator is CORRECTION (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +2.48%), easing weekly but stronger over the month. The yield-curve indicator is BELOW TREND (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -0.49%); duration preference is also BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.51%).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Broad weekly participation, with XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +6.73%) and XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.53% | 1M: +4.02%); XLK is BELOW TREND (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -16.15%). Tech/financials relative strength is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -11.80%), with sector breadth also favoring Financials over Technology; style: value/cyclicals over growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities are in RECOVERY: SPY (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -5.70%); emerging markets are also in RECOVERY: EEM (1W: +2.38% | 1M: -8.53%). India leads the available regional comparison: INDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +12.78%); Europe versus US is ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +1.83%), while EM versus US is BELOW TREND (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -1.24%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Small caps are rebounding: IWM RECOVERY (1W: +3.62% | 1M: -2.67%), while speculative appetite remains weak, with ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +0.83% | 1M: -19.30%). Crypto remains under pressure: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.48% | 1M: -26.61%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity signals are split: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -17.53%) and GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -10.47%). Agriculture versus market is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +3.22%), while the copper/gold ratio is BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.24%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy is rebounding weekly but weak monthly: XLE RECOVERY (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -9.91%) and BNO RECOVERY (1W: +0.15% | 1M: -15.98%). Natural gas is in CORRECTION: UNG (1W: -4.09% | 1M: +3.58%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Broad weekly breadth is confirmed at 11/11, with IWM RECOVERY (1W: +3.62% | 1M: -2.67%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.14% | 1M: +0.77%) showing divergent horizons across risk assets and duration. SPY RECOVERY (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -5.70%) and QQQ RECOVERY (1W: +0.92% | 1M: -10.28%) confirm a short-term bounce, not a monthly trend reversal.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Stay selective within the NEUTRAL regime: favor broad participation and relative financial strength, while reducing exposure to weak-trend growth and speculative areas. XLK is BELOW TREND (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -16.15%); QQQ is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.92% | 1M: -10.28%), and TLT is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.14% | 1M: +0.77%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: If broad breadth holds and cyclical leadership persists, monitor XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.53% | 1M: +4.02%) and XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +6.73%).
BEARISH: If tech weakness continues, watch XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -16.15%) and the tech/financials ratio BELOW TREND (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -11.80%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: If industrial demand indicators stabilize, monitor CPER, currently BELOW TREND (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -17.53%).
BEARISH: If energy weakness persists, watch USO BELOW TREND (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -17.29%) and XLE RECOVERY (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -9.91%).

**13. Key Levels?**
Reference points: VXX 22.4000 (1W: -6.00% | 1M: +25.91%) CORRECTION; HYG/LQD 0.7366 (1W: +0.05% | 1M: -0.67%) RECOVERY. Also monitor SPY/TLT 8.9617 (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -3.36%) RECOVERY and Tech/Financials 2.8018 (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -11.80%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive; participation is broad, but risk and cycle signals conflict. Relative strength is appearing in consumer, defensive, and small-cap ETFs, with value/cyclicals leading technology. Monitor persistent monthly weakness in XLK and credit, despite the broad weekly rebound.
